'''July 2001 Milford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Milford on 14 July 2001. [[Eric Hunter]] won it. It is known from Michael Hawley's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2659">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-18-father-william-in-milford-7-14-2001d2659/ father-william-in-milford-7-14-2001], DeckTech (Michael "rayc" Hawley, 18 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-18-father-william-in-milford-7-14-2001d2659/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 July 2001
* '''Site:''' Milford
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
